newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Prices and turnover up on Bucharest bourse.
newsitem.headline: Prices and turnover up on Bucharest bourse.

text.p: Prices and turnover rose at the Bucharest stock exchange in its first session since the Christmas holidays, with fertiliser maker Azomures SA taking the bulk of trade on Tuesday.

Two independent indices also rose slighlty, but traders said they saw the upward trend as more a result of the accumulation of buying and selling orders caused by the holidays than a revival of trade.
Azomures took 51.4 million lei of the total turnover of 70.15 million lei. It closed firmer at 13,100 lei, from 11,700 in the previous session on December 19.

Except Carbid Fox SA chemical products maker, which closed weaker at 2,350 lei from 2,600 and Electroceramica SA insulator maker, which lost 800 lei to close at 9,000 lei, all other prices closed stronger.
"It appears that someone has tried to agitate the market by throwing big packages of up to 1,500 shares, mostly Azomures shares, for profit taking. The trick worked," a trader said.
Syringe maker SanevitSA remained suspended together with Foraj Sonde SA drilling company, pending announcements on their shareholders' meetings.
Two unofficial indices -- the VAB, computed by Vanguard SA and Bucharest Investment Group 's BIG -- rose by 1.9 percent and 1.94 percent from the previous session.
